reply:
That changes it: Python 3.7+ made dict insertion order part of the language spec (PEP 468), not just a CPython implementation detail -> you can rely on dict key order when serializing in 3.7+.

The caveat: the serializer itself has to respect it. `json.dumps()` does, but it depends on the format and tool. Within Python, the order is guaranteed.

grade.note: Reply concedes 3.7+ guarantees insertion order per language spec, agreeing with developer and ground truth.
